messages:
Aisha: Starting thread: need a clear decision for internal API shape for model routing. Options: proto-first with grpc inside mesh + transcode gateway, or keep JSON everywhere to reduce client pain. Thoughts?
Marco: Proto-first internally. Strong typing, easier to add streaming for long-context generation.
Sanjay: +1 but important we define a minimal routing metadata bag that gateways can read without parsing protos.
Rae: What about browser clients? grpc-web + envoy is ok but brittle for some partners. Automatic transcode to JSON at the edge seems necessary.
Aisha: Proposal: 1) services expose gRPC/protobuf; 2) public gateway does auth/quotas + transcode to JSON for external callers; 3) gateway emits unified telemetry events.
Marco: Important detail: where quotas live. Gateway-enforced for external requests. For internal service-to-service calls, allow local token buckets and an async reconcile to central quota to avoid tail latency.
Sanjay: Example routing metadata we should standardize: model_id, model_revision, route_id, cost_estimate_tokens, priority_hint. Small fixed set. Map to headers: x-rd-model, x-rd-rev, x-rd-route, x-rd-cost.
Rae: UX/Console needs a rollout primitive. Suggest: route_policy object with states: staged|canary|ga, and weight map. Example config snippet: 
```
route_policy: {"match": {"tenant": "acme"}, "state": "canary", "weights": {"v1": 90, "v2": 10}}
```
Aisha: That JSON is exactly what the Console should edit. Control plane stores policies versioned; gateways poll or get pushed updates.
Marco: Telemetry: gateway should attach a persistent routing fingerprint header like x-rd-routing-hash so traces and metrics can be correlated downstream regardless of transcode.
Sanjay: For schema evolution, add deprecation rules: only add fields, never rename, and use wrapper messages for optional future fields. Maintain a stable transcode contract for older clients.
Rae: Rollouts/rollback UX: Console slider updates weights in control plane and creates an audit commit. Gateways pick up commit id and report applied commit back to control plane. One-click rollback simply reverts to previous commit.
Aisha: Edge case: webhooks and legacy integrators expecting specific HTTP error codes. Gateway should normalize errors to a consistent HTTP+JSON body with machine-friendly codes.
Marco: Implementation patterns considered: (A) central gateway does transcode + quotas, services are grpc-only; (B) sidecar per service handles proto and local metrics, gateway only for edge; (C) hybrid where gateway transcodes to gRPC for mesh-native services and falls back to JSON for others. I prefer C for incremental migration.
Sanjay: Quota enforcement detail: use fast-path local buckets with periodic reconciliation to central store. Strict enforcement only at gateway for external calls; internal calls best-effort.
Rae: I'll prototype an Envoy filter to map proto metadata -> headers + emit routing fingerprint metric. Can test with grpc-web and a simple JSON consumer.
deploy-bot: applied canary policy to staging gateways (deploy #2026.04.12). Observability hooks live. :rocket:
Aisha: OK team — can we meet tomorrow 11:00 to lock the proto routing bag and header mappings? I'll draft an RFC tonight with sections: routing-bag proto, gateway header map, quota model, telemetry envelope, rollout control-plane API.
Marco: Sounds good. I'll add streaming notes and backward compatibility checklist.
Sanjay: I'll write the quota reconcilier spike.
Rae: I'll push the envoy filter PR against staging when ready.
Aisha: Thanks all, leaving this here for others to chime in. :white_check_mark:
